categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and adds unit tests across four test files (src/test/script_segwit_tests.cpp, script_tests.cpp, sigopcount_tests.cpp, and script_standard_tests.cpp) to expand coverage of script.cpp.
categories.rationale: The PR adds unit tests across four script test suites to kill 12 live mutants from mutation testing in script.cpp, but adding tests for coverage's sake rather than realistic regressions ranks low. Category guidelines specify that 'adding tests for their own sake ranks low; adding a test that catches a realistic regression ranks high'. The additions test synthetic boundary conditions and mutants rather than demonstrated failure modes, and reviewers noted that some tests (such as script_GetOp_truncated) did not even kill the mutants claimed.
